3
Wɔne Kristo baakoyɛ
1 # Kol 2.12 Enti sɛ moanya ne Kristo anyane a, monhwehwɛ deɛ ɛwɔ soro, deɛ Kristo teɛ hɔ, wɔ Nyankopɔn nifa. 2#Mat 6.33 Monnwene deɛ ɛwɔ soro, na ɛnyɛ deɛ ɛwɔ asase soɔ. 3#Rom 6.2 Na moawu, na wɔde mo nkwa aka Kristo ho ahunta Nyankopɔn mu; 4#1 Ko 15.43 na da a Kristo a ɔne yɛn nkwa bɛyi ne ho adie no, ɛno na wɔbɛyi mo nso ne no adie animuonyam mu.
Kristo mu baakoyɛ ho aba
5 # Rom 6.6; 8.13 Enti monkum mo akwaa a ɛwɔ asase soɔ no, adwamammɔ, efideɛyɛ, akɔnnɔ nhyɛsoɔ, akɔnnɔ bɔne ne anibereɛ a ɛyɛ abosonsom. 6#Efe 5.6 Yeinom na ɛde Nyankopɔn abufuo ba, [wɔ asoɔdenfoɔ mma so]#3.6 Tete atwerɛfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn tom binom mfa yei nka ho. 7ɛno na akane a mote mu no, mo nso monantee wɔ mu.
Esu foforɔ
8 # Efe 4.31; 4.29 Na afei mo deɛ, monyi abufuo, koko bɔne, bɔnepɛ, abususɛm, ne aniwusɛm nyinaa mfiri mo anomu ngu. 9#Efe 4.25; 4.22 Monnnidi atorɔ nnkyerɛkyerɛ mo ho, ɛfiri sɛ moayi onipa dada no ne ne nneyɛɛ agu, 10#Efe 4.24; Gye 1.27 na moahyɛ onipa foforɔ a wɔayɛ no foforɔ aba nimdeɛ mapa mu a ɛgyina deɛ ɔbɔɔ no no suban soɔ; 11#Gal 3.28 faako a Helani ne Yudani, twetiatwa ne momonotoyɛ, ɔpɔtɔni, Skiteni, akoa anaa ɔdehyeɛ bi nni hɔ bio, na mmom Kristo ne ade nyinaa wɔ wɔn nyinaa mu no.
Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsua Kristo abrabɔ
12 # 1 Pe 2.9 Enti ɛnam sɛ moyɛ nnipa a Onyankopɔn ayi mo, ahotefoɔ ne adɔfo yi, monhyɛ timmɔborɔ, ayamyɛ, ahobrɛaseɛ adwene, ɔdwoɔ ne abodwokyɛre. 13#Mat 6.14; Efe 4.2; 4.32 Na sɛ obi ne obi nya asɛm bi a, monhunu mmema mo ho, na momfa nkyekyɛ mo ho; sɛdeɛ Awurade de akyɛ mo no, sɛdeɛ mo nso monyɛ ne no. 14#Rom 13.8; 13.10 Na yeinom nyinaa so na monhyɛ ɔdɔ a ɛka nnoɔma nyinaa bɔ mu ma ɛwie pɛyɛ no nguo. 15#Flp 4.7; 1 Ko 12.13; 12.27 Na momma Kristo asomdwoeɛ nni hene wɔ mo akoma mu, ɛno mu nso na wɔafrɛ mo aba, nipadua baako mu; na monnyɛ bonniayɛfoɔ.
Abrabɔ nnyinasoɔ
16 # Efe 5.19 Momma Kristo asɛm no ntena mo mu bebree, monkyerɛkyerɛ na monkasa nkyerɛ mo ho, nyansa nyinaa mu, momfa sankuo so nnwom, ne ayeyie, nnwom ne honhom mu nnwom nto dwom ɔdɛ so wɔ mo akoma mu mma Onyankopɔn. 17#1 Ko 10.31 Na biribiara a moyɛ no, kasa mu oo! nneyɛɛ mu oo! monyɛ ne nyinaa Awurade Yesu din mu mfa ne so nna Agya Nyankopɔn ase.
Ɛyerenom, okununom, mma, awofoɔ, nkoa ne awuranom
(Efesofoɔ 5.22—6.9)
18Ɛyerenom, mommrɛ mo ho ase mma mo kununom, sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ wɔ Awurade mu. 19#1 Pe 3.7 Okununom, monnɔ mo yerenom, na monnhyɛ wɔn ahometeɛ. 20Mma, montie mo awofoɔ asɛm nnoɔma nyinaa mu, na yei na ɛsɔ Awurade ani. 21Agyanom, monnhyɛ mo mma abufuo, na wɔn abam ammu. 22Nkoa, montie mo honam fam wuranom asɛm nnoɔma nyinaa mu, ɛnyɛ anisoɔ som mu, sɛ wɔn a wɔsɔ nnipa ani, na mmom akoma kronn mu, sɛ wɔn a wɔsuro Awurade. 23Na adwuma biara a moyɛ no, momfiri akoma mu nyɛ no sɛ moyɛ ma Awurade na monyɛ mma nnipa, 24ɛfiri sɛ monim sɛ Awurade nsam na mobɛnya apɛgyadeɛ sɛ akatua, na Awurade Kristo na mosom no. 25#Rom 2.11 Na deɛ ɔyɛ deɛ ɛntene no bɛnya deɛ ɛntene a ɔyɛeɛ no so akatua, na nnipa animhwɛ nni mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Enti sɛ moanya ne Kristo anyane a, monhwehwɛ deɛ ɛwɔ soro, deɛ Kristo teɛ hɔ, wɔ Nyankopɔn nifa. Monnwene deɛ ɛwɔ soro, na ɛnyɛ deɛ ɛwɔ asase soɔ. Na moawu, na wɔde mo nkwa aka Kristo ho ahunta Nyankopɔn mu; na da a Kristo a ɔne yɛn nkwa bɛyi ne ho adie no, ɛno na wɔbɛyi mo nso ne no adie animuonyam mu.

Enti monkum mo akwaa a ɛwɔ asase soɔ no, adwamammɔ, efideɛyɛ, akɔnnɔ nhyɛsoɔ, akɔnnɔ bɔne ne anibereɛ a ɛyɛ abosonsom. Yeinom na ɛde Nyankopɔn abufuo ba, [wɔ asoɔdenfoɔ mma so] ɛno na akane a mote mu no, mo nso monantee wɔ mu.

Na afei mo deɛ, monyi abufuo, koko bɔne, bɔnepɛ, abususɛm, ne aniwusɛm nyinaa mfiri mo anomu ngu. Monnnidi atorɔ nnkyerɛkyerɛ mo ho, ɛfiri sɛ moayi onipa dada no ne ne nneyɛɛ agu, na moahyɛ onipa foforɔ a wɔayɛ no foforɔ aba nimdeɛ mapa mu a ɛgyina deɛ ɔbɔɔ no no suban soɔ; faako a Helani ne Yudani, twetiatwa ne momonotoyɛ, ɔpɔtɔni, Skiteni, akoa anaa ɔdehyeɛ bi nni hɔ bio, na mmom Kristo ne ade nyinaa wɔ wɔn nyinaa mu no.

Enti ɛnam sɛ moyɛ nnipa a Onyankopɔn ayi mo, ahotefoɔ ne adɔfo yi, monhyɛ timmɔborɔ, ayamyɛ, ahobrɛaseɛ adwene, ɔdwoɔ ne abodwokyɛre. Na sɛ obi ne obi nya asɛm bi a, monhunu mmema mo ho, na momfa nkyekyɛ mo ho; sɛdeɛ Awurade de akyɛ mo no, sɛdeɛ mo nso monyɛ ne no. Na yeinom nyinaa so na monhyɛ ɔdɔ a ɛka nnoɔma nyinaa bɔ mu ma ɛwie pɛyɛ no nguo. Na momma Kristo asomdwoeɛ nni hene wɔ mo akoma mu, ɛno mu nso na wɔafrɛ mo aba, nipadua baako mu; na monnyɛ bonniayɛfoɔ.

Momma Kristo asɛm no ntena mo mu bebree, monkyerɛkyerɛ na monkasa nkyerɛ mo ho, nyansa nyinaa mu, momfa sankuo so nnwom, ne ayeyie, nnwom ne honhom mu nnwom nto dwom ɔdɛ so wɔ mo akoma mu mma Onyankopɔn. Na biribiara a moyɛ no, kasa mu oo! nneyɛɛ mu oo! monyɛ ne nyinaa Awurade Yesu din mu mfa ne so nna Agya Nyankopɔn ase.


Ɛyerenom, mommrɛ mo ho ase mma mo kununom, sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ wɔ Awurade mu. Okununom, monnɔ mo yerenom, na monnhyɛ wɔn ahometeɛ. Mma, montie mo awofoɔ asɛm nnoɔma nyinaa mu, na yei na ɛsɔ Awurade ani. Agyanom, monnhyɛ mo mma abufuo, na wɔn abam ammu. Nkoa, montie mo honam fam wuranom asɛm nnoɔma nyinaa mu, ɛnyɛ anisoɔ som mu, sɛ wɔn a wɔsɔ nnipa ani, na mmom akoma kronn mu, sɛ wɔn a wɔsuro Awurade. Na adwuma biara a moyɛ no, momfiri akoma mu nyɛ no sɛ moyɛ ma Awurade na monyɛ mma nnipa, ɛfiri sɛ monim sɛ Awurade nsam na mobɛnya apɛgyadeɛ sɛ akatua, na Awurade Kristo na mosom no. Na deɛ ɔyɛ deɛ ɛntene no bɛnya deɛ ɛntene a ɔyɛeɛ no so akatua, na nnipa animhwɛ nni mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
